preview.text: India Champions won the toss and chose to bowl first against England Champions in a T20 match at Sharjah Cricket Stadium. The usual first-innings score in the 82 recorded T20 matches at Sharjah Cricket Stadium is 153. The forecast for the next 8 hours is up to a 0 per cent chance of rain and about 29 degrees.

summary.text: England Champions won by 21 runs. ENGCH made 192-4, Ravi Bopara (c) top-scoring with 83 off 46 balls; Abhimanyu Mithun took 2 for 27. INDCH made 76-4, Robin Uthappa top-scoring with 31 off 12 balls; Ryan Sidebottom took 2 for 24. Sides batting first at Sharjah Cricket Stadium usually make about 153.
